## Comprehensive Spotify API Usage Report

I've completed a thorough exploration of the SmarterPlaylists codebase. Here's a detailed breakdown of ALL Spotify API integration points:

### 1. **OAuth/Authentication Flow**

**File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/server/spotify_auth.py`

**OAuth Implementation Details:**
- **Client Credentials:**
  - `SPOTIPY_CLIENT_ID` (environment variable)
  - `SPOTIPY_CLIENT_SECRET` (environment variable)
  - `SPOTIPY_REDIRECT_URI` (environment variable)
- **Authorization Endpoint:** `https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token`
- **Auth Flow Type:** Authorization Code Flow (standard OAuth 2.0)
- **HTTP Methods Used:**
  - POST to `https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token` for token exchange
  - POST to `https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token` for token refresh

**Key Methods:**
- `_get_new_token(authorization_code)` - Exchanges auth code for access/refresh tokens
- `_refresh_token(token)` - Refreshes expired tokens
- `_me(token)` - Gets user info via `https://api.spotify.com/v1/me`
- `_spget(method, auth, params)` - Generic GET wrapper for Spotify API v1
- Token expiration handling with 120-second threshold

---

### 2. **Backend Spotify API Integration (Python)**

#### **Main Spotify Plugs Library**
**File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/pbl/pbl/spotify_plugs.py`

Uses **spotipy** library with these endpoints and methods:

**Track/Playlist Sources:**
- **PlaylistSource class**
  - `search(q=name, type='playlist')` - Search playlists
  - `user_playlists(user)` - List user playlists
  - `playlist_tracks(playlist_id, limit=100, offset=N)` - Get playlist tracks (paginated)
  - `next()` - Pagination support for playlist results

- **TrackSource class**
  - `tracks(uris)` - Get multiple tracks by URI

- **TrackSourceByName class**
  - `search(q=name, type='track')` - Search tracks

- **AlbumSource class**
  - `search(q=title + ' ' + artist, type='album')` - Search albums
  - `album_tracks(id)` - Get all tracks from an album

- **ArtistTopTracks class**
  - `search(q=name, type='artist')` - Search artists
  - `artist_top_tracks(id)` - Get top tracks for an artist

**Playlist Operations (Sink):**
- **PlaylistSave class**
  - `user_playlist_create(user, playlist_name)` - Create new playlist
  - `user_playlist_replace_tracks(user, playlist_id, track_uris)` - Replace all tracks (batched)
  - `user_playlist_add_tracks(user, playlist_id, track_uris)` - Append tracks (batched)

**Data Annotation/Enrichment:**
- `_annotate_tracks_with_spotify_data_full(tids)` - Gets track details
  - Calls `tracks(tids)` - Batch get track metadata
  - Calls `albums(batch)` - Get album info (up to 20 per batch)
  - Calls `artists(batch)` - Get artist info (up to 50 per batch)
  - Extracts: duration_ms, explicit, popularity, track_number, disc_number, album data, artist data

- `_annotate_tracks_with_audio_features(tids)`
  - Calls `audio_features(tids)` - Get Spotify audio analysis data

**URI Normalization:**
- Converts `https://open.spotify.com/` URLs to `spotify:` URIs
- Handles old playlist format: `spotify:user:USERNAME:playlist:ID`

**Scopes Required:**
- `playlist-modify-public` 
- `playlist-modify-private`

### 5. **Frontend Direct Spotify API Calls**

**File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/web/callback.html`

Direct HTTP requests to Spotify API (note: these use access_token in Authorization header):

**User Info:**
- `GET https://api.spotify.com/v1/me` - Get current user

**Playlist Operations:**
- `POST https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{username}/playlists` - Create playlist
  - Parameters: name, public (boolean)
  
- `POST https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{username}/playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks` - Add tracks
  - Body: `{ uris: [...] }` (batch up to 100 per request)
  
- `PUT https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{username}/playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks` - Replace all tracks
  - Body: `{ uris: [...] }` (batch up to 100 per request)

**Track Info:**
- `GET https://api.spotify.com/v1/tracks/{track_id}` - Get track details

### 6. **Echo Nest API Integration (Deprecated)**

**File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/pbl/pbl/echonest_plugs.py`

Uses **pyen** library to call Echo Nest API:

  - Type: 'genre-radio', 'artist-radio', 'artist'
  - Buckets: id:spotify, audio_summary, song_hotttnesss, song_currency, artist_hotttnesss, tracks, artist_familiarity, artist_discovery

**Data Annotation:**
- `_annotate_tracks_with_echonest_data(tids)`
  - Calls `song/profile` endpoint with Spotify track URIs
  - Returns: acousticness, danceability, energy, instrumentalness, key, liveness, loudness, mode, speechiness, tempo, time_signature, valence, artist_hotttnesss, artist_familiarity, artist_discovery, song_hotttnesss, song_currency

**pyen Library (HTTP wrapper):**
- **File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/pyen/pyen.py`
- Base URL: `http://developer.echonest.com/api/v4/`
- Uses `requests.request()` for GET/POST
- Built-in rate limiting and retry logic (max 5 retries)

### 7. **Flask Server Endpoints (Authentication Flow)**

**File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/server/flask_server.py`

**Authentication-Related Endpoints:**
- `POST /SmarterPlaylists/save` - Save program (with auth_code validation)
- `POST /SmarterPlaylists/delete` - Delete program (with auth_code validation)
- `POST /SmarterPlaylists/copy` - Copy program (with auth_code validation)
- `POST /SmarterPlaylists/import` - Import program (with auth_code validation)
- `GET /SmarterPlaylists/directory` - List user's programs (with auth_code)
- `GET /SmarterPlaylists/program` - Get program details (with auth_code)
- `GET /SmarterPlaylists/schedule_status` - Get schedule status (with auth_code)
- `GET /SmarterPlaylists/config` - Return Spotify client_id to frontend

**Token Management:**

### 8. **Configuration & Components**

**File:** `/Users/brunobrunkow/Downloads/SmarterPlaylists-master/app/server/components.py`

Available annotations/enrichments:
